Clients can use this status to route around unavailable tools before calling.Workspaces with a billing restriction,

The new [Developer portal](https://www.notion.so/developers) is now available as a single place to manage developer tools for Notion, including connections, Workers, and personal access tokens.[Personal access tokens](/guides/connections-and-tokens/personal-access-tokens) (PATs) are user-scoped tokens for scripts, CLI workflows, Workers, and trusted tools that should act with one Notion user’s permissions. PATs can be granted Notion API access, Workers access, or both.Workspace admins can now view and revoke PATs created in their workspace. On supported plans, admins can also configure who may create PATs with Notion API access. Defaults vary by plan: Free workspaces default to workspace owners only, Plus workspaces default to all workspace members, Business workspaces default to workspace owners only, and Enterprise workspaces default to workspace owners and selected groups.

title: Your connected workspace for wiki, docs & projects | Notion
snippet:
### API access
Get access to Notion's Discovery API and documentation, including our Partner Onboarding wiki.
### Notion Academy
Join the Notion Academy with exclusive product training for our partners.

Please apply to our Technology Partner Program using [this form](https://notionup.typeform.com/to/DWbNQjjE?typeform-source=www.notion.so) and for the question "What partner category do you fall into?", select "Security & Compliance partner".

What are the requirements for becoming a Notion Security and Compliance partner?
Eligible Security and Compliance partners will need to reach a threshold of shared customers of Notion, specialize in a supported security and compliance use case as outlined on this page, and have plans to build a Notion integration for shared customers.
What are the benefits of being in the program?
Admitted Security and Compliance partners will have access to Discovery API documentation through our Notion workspace. You'll also have access to our Business Development and Partner Engineering teams and co-marketing opportunities.

title: Join the Technology Partner Program | Notion
snippet:
Notion works best when it's connected with the other tools that power your work. Notion technology partners help build those integrations — connecting workflows, driving productivity, and delighting our joint users.

I have built a Notion integration — do I qualify to become a Notion technology partner?
Having a live public integration is a key prerequisite to becoming a Notion technology partner. We are looking for partners that thoughtfully extend Notion’s capabilities with integrations that our customers use and love. But integrations alone don't make a partnership — we want to work with partners who share our focus, mission, and vision. If you believe your integration and company are a fit, please fill out the form linked on this page and our partnership team will reach out!

The Notion API is publicly available for anyone to explore. You can find our documentation and get started at [developers.notion.com](https://developers.notion.com). You can create internal integrations for private use or build public integrations that are available to Notion users and apply to become a Notion technology partner afterward.

title: Notion API Quickstart: Get a Key and Make Your First Call
snippet:
You can create an integration on any of the four plans, so your plan tier doesn't restrict your ability to build integrations, though Business and Enterprise get a higher rate limit. Price per member is the other difference that matters for this decision.
| Plan | API access per Notion docs | Price per member per month |
|---|---|---|
| Free | Included | $0 |
| Plus | Included | $10 per seat / month |
| Business | Included | Listed on Notion's pricing page |
| Enterprise | Included | Quoted by Notion sales |
Before anyone approves spend, Free lets you prove the integration works. On Plus, the $2 gap between annual and monthly billing is the cost of staying flexible, so choose monthly only if you may drop the plan soon.

title: Personal access tokens
snippet:
Personal access tokens (PATs) let one Notion user call the Notion API or work with Notion Workers. A PAT belongs to one workspace. For Notion API requests, it uses the workspace membership and page permissions of the person who created it. Use a PAT when API requests should act as you and you don’t need an [internal connection](/guides/connections-and-tokens/internal-connections) or the [OAuth flow for a public connection](/guides/connections-and-tokens/public-integrations/overview).

You can give a PAT either or both of these capabilities:
| Capability | What it allows |
|---|---|
| **Notion API** | Read, create, update, and search content; read and create comments; and read supported user information through Notion’s REST API. |
| **Workers** | Deploy and manage [Notion Workers](/workers/get-started/overview) with the Notion CLI. |

| Plan | Default PAT creation policy | Admin controls |
|---|---|---|
| Free | Workspace owners only. | Not configurable. |
| Plus | All workspace members. | Not configurable. |
| Business | Workspace owners only. | Admins can choose **Workspace owners only** or **All workspace members**. |
| Enterprise | Workspace owners and selected groups. | Admins can choose **Workspace owners only**, **Workspace owners and selected groups**, or **All workspace members**. |
